reverie.title: REVERIE — the shed at dusk where cloth learned patience
narr: You sit across from her, the loom between you.
She pulls thread; the pattern grows without hurrying.
Her hands know the count. She does not speak.
The light is leaving the shed, but the cloth glows.
She says: this is how the archive begins — someone
deciding one thread matters enough to hold.
